title: Esrbespoke parallax frame
description: A cropped media frame whose picture drifts at a different speed from the page as it scrolls by (scrubbed parallax), optionally fading in as it enters or rising 16px on load. Empty, it is a plain muted placeholder of the frame's size.
notes: the frame takes its size from className (h-svh, aspect-[4/3]…); the media fills it like object-fit: cover
parallax is CSS scroll-driven (view timeline) inside @supports; elsewhere the picture simply sits still
name: esrbespoke-parallax

props.name: media
props.description: the picture or video; it should fill its box (`h-full w-full object-cover`). Empty: a placeholder

props.name: drift
props.description: how the picture drifts: "cover" while the frame crosses the window, "exit" for a frame at the page top, "none"

props.name: fadeIn
props.description: fade the picture in as the frame enters the window

props.name: rise
props.description: rise 16px into place on page load (the inner pages' hero photo)

props.name: placeholderClassName
props.description: classes for the placeholder surface when there is no media
